description: Split each target into a grid of rectangles (Object > Path > Split Into Grid): rows and columns with gutters, taking the target's fill, stroke and opacity. The target is replaced. Optionally add guides along the grid

addGuides.description: Add guides along the cell edges. Default false

gutter.description: Points between cells, both ways. Default 0

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: split_into_grid
title: Split Into Grid
